title: More than 700 digital enrolment stations to be deployed nationwide by end of 2026 - Muntaka

title: Humana-Paredes, Wilkerson rally to win bronze on home soil in Montreal Elite16
desc: The Canadian beach volleyball duo of Melissa Humana-Paredes and Brandie Wilkerson secured bronze on home soil at the Montreal Elite16 tournament. The 2024 Olympic silver medallists rallied to overcome Germany’s Svenja Müller and Cinja Tillmann by scores of 20-22, 21-12 and 18-16 to land on the podium.

title: Beloved actor Shelley Fabares, star of 'The Donna Reed Show,' dies at 82

title: Two Phoenix police officers arrested and fired after violent, unreported traffic stop
